_doc: #1211 Store > Access > Apps MCP-API: what each app in Store > Cloud > Apps (the fleet group `apps_group`) declares as endpoints, in three kinds. An app's entry under `apps` (keyed by its fleet id) lists its own endpoints per kind; a kind it does not list is MISSING and the page says so. Nothing here is invented: an endpoint appears only when the app serves it. The `debug` kind has a default, the shared lib (`shared_debug`): every app inherits those GET + POST routes of c3-infra-api unless its entry sets `debug` itself.
